text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You will also be running in next week's 
exhibition race, correct?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... It feels like it's been a 
while since I could go all out. My heart 
is dancing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, I don't dislike that. I'll gladly 
take you on."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Whether it be love or desire, I 
shall embrace it all and trample it 
underfoot. Go ahead, unleash that 
"something" lurking within you to your 
heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a race, so I will give it my 
all. ...That is... all there is to it."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... How strong, how beautiful...\nWhat 
a crown-worthy pair they are.\n...How 
truly, truly—)
